tells.1: Formulaic 'Mitigation:' labels after every risk, with uniformly parallel, consultant-polished phrasing throughout
tells.2: A bolded inline lead-in on every rationale, reinvestment and risk item, plus the 'I'm happy to walk through' sign-off
tells.4: Markdown '##' headers in what should be a plain memo, and very even, templated section structure

reason: Version 3 is clearly a real person's rough draft, but its vague mitigations and loose phrasing make it weak to send. Version 4 keeps the polished structure, assigns clear owners in active voice ('We will…', 'Finance completes…'), and drops the bold-lead-in clutter, so it is the most credible and readable choice.
